name: PR439 discipline seed probe

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - evidence/pr439-discipline-seed-probe

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  probe:
    name: Ban-order seed ${{ matrix.seed }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        seed:
          - "0x0F1E2D3C4B5A6978"
          - "0x00000000D1A6D05E"
          - "0x0000000000000001"
          - "0x00000000ABCDEF12"
          - "0x0000000099887766"
          - "0x000000005A5A5A5A"
    env:
      PROBE_SEED: ${{ matrix.seed }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: f40f0853909cc2a42190023fea1da72d25409b12

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "8.0.x"

      - name: Replace only the test fixture seed in workspace
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os
          from pathlib import Path

          path = Path("src/season-save/tests/SeasonLoopDisciplineTests.cs")
          text = path.read_text()
          old = "private const ulong WorldSeed = 0x5EED1EA6D0DEC0DEUL;"
          seed = os.environ["PROBE_SEED"]
          new = f"private const ulong WorldSeed = {seed}UL;"
          if text.count(old) != 1:
              raise SystemExit("WorldSeed anchor missing or ambiguous")
          path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
          print(new)
          PY

      - name: Run ban-ordering positive-control test
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash tools/dotnet-ci/run-gate.sh --fast --test-filter 'Name=ANewBanEarnedThisFixtureIsNotServedByThisSameFixture'
